name: shubhmilan-palmistry-kb
embeddingText: feature_key + qualifier + text_en (the string embedded for each chunk; see scripts/ingest-palmistry.ts)

chunkSchema.category: one of: lines | mounts | signs | shapes
chunkSchema.feature_key: canonical feature, e.g. heart_line, mount_venus, star, palm_shape
chunkSchema.qualifier: observed variation, e.g. strong | faint | forked | prominent | earth
chunkSchema.source: attribution string surfaced to the user

userSources.note: Drop palmistry texts (.md/.txt/.json) here. The ingestion script normalizes them into the chunkSchema above before embedding. Curated files above are always ingested; sources/ is additive.
